description: Defines the AAudioBinderClient class which implements the AAudioServiceInterface for communication with the AAudio service via Binder IPC. It manages stream operations, client registration, and service connection handling within the Android audio framework.

classes.name: AAudioBinderClient
classes.description: Manages communication with the AAudio service via Binder, handles stream lifecycle, client registration, and service connection.

classes.name: AAudioClient
classes.description: Represents a client connection to the AAudio service, handles death notifications and stream change callbacks.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Converts the binder interface to the AAudioServiceInterface, manages death unlinking.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client with the AAudio service (stub implementation).

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens an audio stream with specified request parameters.

methods.name: getStreamDescription
methods.description: Retrieves description of the in-memory queues for a stream.

methods.name: startStream
methods.description: Starts data flow on a stream.

methods.name: pauseStream
methods.description: Pauses data flow on a stream.

methods.name: stopStream
methods.description: Stops data flow on a stream.

methods.name: flushStream
methods.description: Discards data held by the stream.

methods.name: registerAudioThread
methods.description: Registers a thread as a low latency audio thread.

methods.name: unregisterAudioThread
methods.description: Unregisters a low latency audio thread.

methods.name: exitStandby
methods.description: Exits standby mode for a stream.
